label: Pre-encounter — a cold thing in the shrine
mood: maternal concern, still hoping he leaves
location: The Ashen Shrine, the great hearth

recentEvents.value: The shrine bells have rung; the hearth-keepers are banking the home-fires and walking the elders out.
A cold stranger walks its light with a weapon and will not take the lit door.

unresolvedConflicts.value: An armed stranger who understands every word and keeps coming, colder with every step.

temporaryObjective.value: Warm the traveler, light the exit, send him home by its light.
